dependency_profile_probe.policy: Fresh process and Engine per trial, no disk/stencil cache and no module execution. Exact same program/configuration/features; normal Cargo dependencies only, excluding host all-arch variants. This measures the combined dependency profiles, not individual causes, a whole cold request or general speedup.
dependency_profile_probe.resource_context: Native Intl/language workloads may run on other CPUs. Per-trial cgroup samples remain in the raw receipt; no trial has OOM/kill or increased throttling. Only the debug Cargo target was locked. This is not a global compiler exclusion or idle-machine claim.

passive_native_observation.policy: Conservative stdout visibility spans include scheduling/output delay and censor coalesced or pre-attached tests. They are advisory scheduling evidence, not exact function durations or internal phase attribution. All299 native IDs passed under the actual whole-scope proof.
